content.text:
The product search index is rebuilt every hour from a full export. Each rebuild takes 40 minutes, so new products stay invisible for up to an hour. Customers filed 23 tickets about missing products in July 2026.

Source: `specs/search-index-rewrite.md`, the problem statement just before "## Proposal".

The changelog (`changelog/2026.md`) says the rebuild moved from nightly to hourly. That context isn't part of the problem statement.
